details.completeness_justification: All six key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by S2 (revenue growth), S6 (EBITDA growth), and S10 (EBT growth). K2 is covered by S3 (Big 3 titles' revenue share) and S4 (Truck Manager and Farm Manager's role). K3 is covered by S8 (IAA revenue doubling) and S9 (monetization efficiency improvement). K4 is covered by S18 (2026 financial guidance). K5 is covered by S15 (solvency ratio) and S16 (liquidity position and share buy-back). K6 is covered by S4 (framework-driven development) and S18 (development efficiencies). No material omissions affect the overall understanding.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction. Revenue growth (S2) is explained by successful titles (S3) and new releases (S4). The EBITDA margin decline (S6) is logically attributed to increased marketing spend (S7). The significant EBT growth (S10) is contextualized by non-recurring charges in the prior year (S11-S12). Cash flow movements (S16-S17) are clearly explained by specific timing factors. The summary concludes with forward-looking guidance (S18) that logically follows from stated operational strengths. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition that materially impact coherence.
